deviations.text: The definition-A contamination cleanup underneath the slot0nm corpus had spot-check verdict REPORT_TO_OPERATOR (base 17, residual 5 of 6000); operator accepted 2026-09-16.

1 row excluded from BOTH arms (251598 of 251599); the control was rebuilt on the slot0nm id set so the pair shares one sampler permutation. The historic slot0 number (CFG0 CLAP 0.2029) was trained on all 251599 rows and is NOT the paired control.
056 (slot0clean, measurements kept) was stopped at Stage 1 it ~2,050; no contamination-only arm exists, so contamination cleanup and measurement removal stay bundled in slot0nm.

The full arm was authorized up front, not gated on the seed pair's outcome (operator: 'one seed pair then full'). It has no matched slot0 full control at the same id set; the comparator is the historic full table, which differs by one row.

hypothesis.question: Does the slot0nm corpus (contamination cleaned + guessed measurements removed) change MusicCaps CFG0 or CFG3+neg at full scale?
hypothesis.why_now: 057 (slot0nm quarter, seed 14159265) tied slot0 on the preregistered CFG0 primary (+0.0031 = 0.74x seed floor) and was positive on every CFG3+neg cell (+0.0045 batch-32 CLAP), but the CFG3+neg training-seed floor was measured at full scale with only 2 seeds and is likely underestimated, and the slot0 comparator was trained on a different row set.
hypothesis.what_moves: 29956 of 251599 rows differ between the two arms.
hypothesis.not_controlled: Contamination cleanup and measurement removal are bundled.
hypothesis.eval_caveat: MusicCaps CLAP does not measure tempo/key/meter adherence; these arms cannot show the fabricated measurements were harmful or harmless for those attributes.
hypothesis.seed_floor_caveat: CFG0 floor CLAP 0.0042 (2x = 0.0084). No quarter-scale CFG3+neg floor exists; do not divide CFG3+neg margins by the full-scale 2-seed floor.

decision_rule.rule: CFG0 CLAP is the primary cell. Margins under 2x the CFG0 seed floor (0.0084 CLAP) are ties. The full comparator differs by one row and was trained at the same seed, so it is a single unpaired comparison.
